title: Plant Material Preparation and Salt Imposition for PlantScreen Analysis
author: Mariam Awlia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4xzgxp6
materials: Put agar into a 200 mL beaker­­.
Put in microwave to dissolve for 00:03:00 .
Cover beaker with foil or cling film.
FC measurement with Light curve protocol.

steps.title: Prepare Germination Trays
steps.instruction: Pot sieved soil into germination trays (G Trays with 24 pots).

steps.title: Pre-saturate Germination Soil
steps.instruction: Saturate the soil and prepare for sowing.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 L of water to saturate the soil.
Cover with a transparent lid.
Remove excess water from all trays and leave to drip for one day before sowing.

steps.title: Sow Seeds
steps.instruction: Sow seeds into the germination trays according to the Master GTray List.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a traylist for Plantscreen and ID stickers for pots.
Cut the end of a pipette tip; use a pipette with this wide tip to sow seeds, separating seeds by pipetting in a line.
Sow approximately 30 seeds per pot per accession.

steps.title: Initial Growth Phase
steps.instruction: Place trays in the growth chamber and manage humidity.

substeps.instruction: Put trays in the growth chamber.
Remove lids after 3-5 days (earlier if lids are too humid).

steps.title: Prepare PlantScreen Trays
steps.instruction: Pot sieved soil into PlantScreen trays (P Trays with 20 pots).

substeps.instruction: Weigh each pot to ensure ± 60 g of soil by taring one empty pot and weighing each pot + soil.
Add 2.5 L of water to saturate the soil and cover with a transparent lid.
Remove excess water from all trays and leave to drip for one day before transplanting.

steps.title: Transplant Seedlings
steps.instruction: Transplant seedlings from germination trays to PlantScreen trays after 1 week of growth.

substeps.instruction: Choose similar sized seedlings.
Transplant 2-3 seedlings per pot, taking the seedling with the surrounding soil.

steps.title: Post-Transplant Growth
steps.instruction: Maintain seedlings in the growth chamber.

substeps.instruction: Cover with transparent lids for 3-5 days, leaving an open area to reduce humidity formation.
Place trays in the growth chamber, arranging them in batches of 6 on shelves for maximum light incidence (no shadow).
Thin-out extra seedlings after 1 week.

steps.title: Register and Water Plants
steps.instruction: Register plants in the PlantScreen system and manage hydration.

substeps.instruction: Register trays in PlantScreen using the import function in the PlantScreen Registration program.
Add the reference weight of all trays using the Plant Watering program.
Water trays in PlantScreen to the specified percentage of field capacity.

steps.title: Prepare for Salt Stress
steps.instruction: Grow plants to the 10-leaf rosette stage (approx. 21-23 days old) and prepare reagents.

substeps.instruction: Water trays in PlantScreen to the specified percentage of field capacity the day before salt imposition.
Prepare weigh boats of NaCl in 2L bottles using distilled water (dH2O).
Prepare bottles of dH2O for control plants.
Remove all Australian pots to ease the salt imposition process.

steps.title: Apply Salt Stress
steps.instruction: Perform bottom-watering with NaCl solution for small pots and black trays.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 250 millimolar (mM) NaCl (29.22 g) in 2 L of water.
Perform bottom-watering for 01:00:00.

steps.title: Perform PlantScreen Imaging
steps.instruction: Capture RGB, FC (Lightcurve), and IR images.

substeps.instruction: Set timing for 01:20:00 (1 hour and 20 mins) to ensure consistency across future scannings.
Turn off all lights.
Turn IR light on 100% and others off.
Turn on the 3 lights at 22%.

steps.title: Seed Dispersion and Cold Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare seeds in agar for cold storage.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mL of normal water.
Add 100 µL to each mini tube.
Add 0.1% agar to eppendorfs and vortex well.
Check eppendorf tubes the next day and vortex again to ensure seeds are dispersed in solution.
Place in fridge at 4 °C for 72:00:00.
